nadia-fischer.name: Nadia Fischer
nadia-fischer.headline: Technical Recruiting at Meridian Labs
nadia-fischer.bio: Hiring systems and infrastructure engineers. I promise to read your profile before I message you.

tom-weber.name: Tom Weber
tom-weber.headline: Senior Editor at The Verge
tom-weber.bio: Covering simulation, infrastructure and the people who maintain it.

sophia-garcia.name: Sophia Garcia
sophia-garcia.headline: Software Engineering Manager at TechCore
sophia-garcia.bio: Building high-performing engineering teams. Open to mentoring junior engineers.

olivia-patel.name: Olivia Patel
olivia-patel.headline: Product Manager at CloudSoft
olivia-patel.bio: Building products that developers love. Product strategy and roadmapping.

p-3104.author: nadia-fischer
p-3104.text: Meridian Labs is opening a simulation infrastructure team. If you have shipped something that replays byte for byte, my inbox is open and I do read it.

p-3110.author: nadia-fischer
p-3110.text: Conference season is coming up. Looking forward to speaking about systems design and scalability.

p-3111.author: tom-weber
p-3111.text: Team lunch today was great. Nothing brings people together like good food and good conversation.

p-3112.author: sophia-garcia
p-3112.text: Excited to announce we are expanding the engineering team at TechCore. If you are passionate about building scalable systems, we would love to hear from you.

p-3113.author: david-lee
p-3113.text: Migrated our microservices to use async processing. Latency improvements across the board. Sometimes the best architecture decision is the simple one.

p-3114.author: olivia-patel
p-3114.text: Released our product roadmap for Q4. Focusing on developer experience improvements based on community feedback.

p-3115.author: marcus-smith
p-3115.text: Just published a case study on our cloud migration project. 5 years of legacy systems successfully modernized.

p-3116.author: sophia-garcia
p-3116.text: Speaking at Tech Leadership Summit 2026. Will be discussing best practices for building inclusive engineering cultures.

p-3117.author: david-lee
p-3117.text: Performance deep dive: our database query times have improved 40% this quarter. Engineering excellence is a team effort.

p-3118.author: olivia-patel
p-3118.text: User research findings: developers prioritize simplicity and speed. Building a product that delights them is our north star.

p-3119.author: tom-weber
p-3119.text: The infrastructure landscape is changing rapidly. Companies investing in developer tooling are winning the talent wars.

messages.text: We are standing up a simulation infrastructure team here and I would like fifteen minutes, entirely off the record. Same city, no relocation, and I am not going to pretend the comp is a secret: it is a band, and it is above yours.
Completely fair. Calendar reminder set for after DevCon. Congratulations on the launch, the Verge piece was good.
